description.narrative:
Projektet ”Supporting Social and Economic Resilience of Vulnerable Women and Girls II (SECuRE II)” är planerat för 2021 - 2024. Projektet implementeras av International Rescue Committee United Kingdom, IRC, och omfattar totalt 120,2 MSEK över en period av tre år.
Projektet har tre huvudmål:
- Kvinnor genererar inkomster på ett säkert sätt och kan kontrollera och använda sina egna resurser. - Kvinnor och flickor stärks i att forma och bidra till sina egna samhällen och hem. - Kvinnor och flickor får skydd och stöd för att återhämta sig från konsekvenser av könsrelaterat våld (GBV).
Projektets syfte är att att öka syriska flyktingkvinnors säkerhet och samtidigt främja deras ekonomiska och sociala motståndskraft i utsatta områden i Libanon och Jordanien. Insatsen fokuserar på att hitta möjligheter till arbete och kvinnors företagande och samtidigt öka deras kunskap om könsrelaterat våld och på så sätt stärka dem både i ekonomiskt oberoende, den egna säkerheten och kontrollen över sina liv. Insatsen riktar sig också till libanesiska och jordanska kvinnor i värdsamhällena. Kvinnorna får yrkesutbildning och ett mindre starta-eget bidrag. De utbildas också i att hantera könsrelaterat våld.
Målsättningen är att nå 45 000 direkta mottagare genom projektet och genom dem 82 000 indirekta mottagare i Libanon och Jordanien.

The project "Supporting Social and Economic Resilience of Vulnerable Women and Girls II (SECuRE II)" is planned for 2021 - 2024. The project is implemented by the International Rescue Committee, IRC, and covers a total of SEK 120.2 million over a period of three years.
The intervention centre on the following three programme objectives:
- Women safely generate income and assets and are able to safely use and control resources. - Women and girls are empowered and supported to shape and contribute to their communities and homes. - Women and girls are protected and supported to recover from the consequences of Gender-Based Violence (GBV).
The aim of the project is to increase women's security and promote their economic and social resilience in vulnerable areas in both Lebanon and Jordan. The project focuses on finding opportunities for work and women's entrepreneurship and at the same time increase their knowledge of gender-based violence and thus strengthen them both in financial independence, their own security and control over their lives.
The project is intended to reach more than 45 000 direct beneficiaries and 82 000 indirectly in Lebanon and Jordan.

The overall goal of the project is: Women and girls are safer and are economically and socially resilient. The project has three sub-objectives: - Women safely generate income and assets and are able to safely use and control resources. - Women and girls are empowered and supported to shape and contribute to their communities and homes. - Women and girls are protected and supported to recover from the consequences of Gender-Based Violence (GBV).

sector.narrative: Ending violence against women and girls

description.narrative:
The team from Consultus that conducted the final evaluation was generally highly positive to the programme: In almost all aspects SECuRE II had been very effective in achieving its objectives and had had a transformative impact on the lives of vulnerable women in both Lebanon and Jordan. The holistic and integrated approach of economic and social empowerment with GBV-protection had been highly successful. Important elements in the achievements were the engagement with men and boys where the evaluators remarked that this work could be regarded as an important accelerator of this programme and should be scaled up further in future interventions. Also the local partnerships, which were marked by a high degree of mutuality and co-creation, had played a key role in the programme´s efficiency.
The final narrative report, including logframe, for SECuRE II shows that the programme has fulfilled all the planned results in relation to the targets, and in many instances the results are considerably above the set targets. SECuRE II was a comprehensive, integrated multisector programme with a multitude of results, both quantitative as well as significant qualitative results.
Below are just a few examples of results achieved during the whole programme: In Lebanon IRC and its partners provided protection and economic empowerment services to 7,933 unique clients. Through integrated interventions, the programme furthermore addressed gender-specific barriers enabling 1,417women to access employment opportunities and boosting working days with 24% despite the challenging economic context in Lebanon.
In Lebanon some 6,834 individuals benefited from GBV-related services, including psychosocial support, case management and awareness sessions with a strong focus on disability inclusion. The programme also supported 93 women-led microbusinesses, resulting in 82 % reporting increased net profits. In Jordan IRC and its partners provided integrated ERD and WPE services in four areas of the country which reached 32,090 unique clients. IRC´s collaboration with community-based organizations allowed for expansion to more remote areas, ensuring vulnerable populations, particularly GBV--survivors, received the necessary support.
Through its WGSSs (Women and Girls Safe Spaces) in Jordan, IRC offered a broad range of comprehensive GBV services, including legal information and personalized support, benefiting 31,345 women and girls. A total of 99 % of women and girls who participated in WGSS activities reported increased community involvement and improved wellbeing due to the WPE activities.
